title: indigo_xml_escape_b() leaks its thread-local long escape buffer when a thread ends
description:
indigo_xml_escape_b() with an index of ESCAPE_BUFFER_COUNT or more escapes into a static INDIGO_THREAD_LOCAL long_escape_buffer grown with indigo_safe_realloc() and never freed. Each thread that escapes a long value with special characters (for example a handler queue thread saving a text property through indigo_save_property()) leaves one buffer behind when it ends, up to 6 x the longest escaped value. LeakSanitizer reported 1183 bytes after the Scheduler Agent case repeat_retry_and_failures. The loss is bounded per thread but repeats for every short-lived thread, such as the handler queue of a driver that is loaded and unloaded. Next (framework change, needs owner approval): free the buffer at thread exit (pthread key destructor or an explicit release helper called when a queue thread ends), or let callers pass their own buffer.
